name: Honey Mustard Dressing
ingredients_raw: Water, Refined Soyabean Oil, Synthetic Vinegar [Water, Acetic Acid (INS260)], Sugar, Milk Solids, Emulsifiers and Stabilizers (INS1442, INS1450, INS415), Honey (3.0%), Liquid Glucose, Culinary Paste-Mustard [2.0% {Water, Mustard Powder, Acetic Acid (INS260), Iodised Salt}], Iodised Salt, Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances, Spices and Condiments, Acidity Regulator (INS330), Preservatives (INS211, INS202), Natural Colour [INS160b(ii)], Antioxidant (INS319) and Sequestrant (INS385).
